# Console smoke test, run after "Done". "wait N" sleeps N seconds; the rest are commands.
boss validate
boss list
forceload add -32 -32 31 31
fill -24 79 -24 24 79 24 minecraft:stone
# Clear the space above too: the world seed is random and terrain would block spawns.
fill -24 80 -24 24 92 24 minecraft:air
wait 2
boss spawn qa_domain 0 80 0
boss spawn qa_melee 6 80 0
boss spawn qa_skin -6 80 0
boss spawn qa_shield 0 80 6
boss spawn qa_golem_disguise 10 80 10
boss spawn qa_golem_giant -12 80 -12
boss spawn qa_golem_small 12 80 -12
boss spawn qa_player_giant -12 80 12
boss spawn qa_player_tiny 4 80 -8
boss spawn qa_player_reach -4 80 -8
boss spawn qa_scale_abilities 16 80 0
boss spawn qa_summon variant hard 0 80 -16
boss minion spawn qa_minion_skin
boss minion spawn qa_scaled_minion
boss minion spawn qa_vanilla_minion
wait 5
# 1.21.x only (1.20.1 has no scale attribute; the script checks the result per version).
# 1.21.1 still names it generic.scale; the name that does not exist only prints "Can't find element".
attribute @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_golem_giant"},limit=1] minecraft:scale get
attribute @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_golem_giant"},limit=1] minecraft:generic.scale get
boss phase @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_domain"}] set 2
boss phase @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_domain"}] set 3
boss phase @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_domain"}] set 4
boss phase @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_domain"}] set 1
boss rage @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_summon"}] start qa_rage
wait 10
boss rage @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_summon"}] end
boss reload
wait 5
# Room check: a 7x3x7 pocket under a stone roof is too small for the x6 boss.
fill 20 80 20 26 82 26 minecraft:air
fill 20 83 20 26 83 26 minecraft:stone
boss spawn qa_huge_room 23 80 23
boss limits qa_summon
boss schedule trigger qa_schedule
boss schedule trigger qa_schedule
boss stats
# Keep qa_domain (in phase 3) for the restart check; remove the rest.
boss kill qa_melee
boss kill qa_skin
boss kill qa_shield
boss kill qa_golem_disguise
boss kill qa_golem_giant
boss kill qa_golem_small
boss kill qa_player_giant
boss kill qa_player_tiny
boss kill qa_player_reach
boss kill qa_scale_abilities
boss kill qa_summon
boss kill qa_schedule
boss minion kill all
boss phase @e[nbt={BossId:"qa_domain"}] set 3
wait 3
save-all flush
wait 3
